description: Native goal lifecycle contract. Every Beastmode goal started through `bm goal run` is a durable record that can be listed, inspected, approved, resumed, cancelled and proven complete without reading a chat transcript. scripts/lib/goal_lifecycle.py is the only writer; scripts/bm-goal and `bm goal <verb>` are the CLI surface.

identity.goal_id: stable identity assigned once at `bm goal run`; format g<UTC yyyymmddThhmmss>-<6 hex>
identity.attempt_id: one supervised harness process; format a<n>, monotonically increasing per goal. Completion and evidence bind to an attempt AND a revision, never to the goal alone
identity.contract_digest: sha256 of the normalized goal text + seats + autonomy + harness. A decision or completion recorded under one digest is stale under another
identity.revision: git rev-parse HEAD of the target worktree at the moment a decision or completion is recorded

outcomes.succeeded: final revision passed every verify command, the provenance gate returned ok for every expected child, and a bound watcher review approved the same revision
outcomes.awaiting_approval: the harness stopped at a durable gate (control/gate.json or a LangGraph interrupt) and recorded the question
outcomes.validation_failed: a verify command exited non-zero at the final revision
outcomes.provenance_failed: scripts/lib/acn_meta.py returned drift or unverifiable for at least one child
outcomes.review_missing: no watcher review bound to the final revision and attempt; `no watcher, no validated`
outcomes.harness_failed: the harness process exited non-zero without a gate handshake
outcomes.infrastructure_failed: the harness could not be started (missing binary, spawn error) or the supervisor died; retryable
outcomes.stalled: no output, receipts, or heartbeat for the configured stall window; retryable
outcomes.budget_exhausted: attempt, elapsed-time or token budget reached; further attempts are refused until the operator raises the budget
outcomes.cancelled: operator cancellation; cleanup is recorded as `confirmed` or `uncertain`
outcomes.supervisor_lost: the record said running but the supervisor process is gone; effects are unknown until reconciled

resume_modes.checkpoint: LangGraph checkpoint resume: the graph continues from the interrupt with Command(resume=decision); no work is repeated
resume_modes.prompt_continuation: shell harnesses restart the harness process in the same worktree with the recorded decisions injected into the prompt; file-system state persists, conversation state does not. Never presented as checkpoint-exact

commands: bm goal run <goal> [bm flags] [--max-attempts N] [--max-seconds N] [--max-tokens N] [--stall-seconds N] [--verify-cmd CMD]... [--expect ID,...] [--attestations PATH] [--notify-cmd CMD] [--queue-only] [--json]
bm goal approve <goal-id> [--decision ID] [--answer KEY=VALUE]... [--actor NAME]
bm goal schedule <goal-id> --at ISO8601|--every SECONDS --export cron|launchd|json

exit_codes.1: goal failed or blocked (validation, provenance, review, harness, stall, budget)
exit_codes.3: breaker: refused by a fail-closed policy (bm model preflight, Claude OAuth seat, remote dispatch)
exit_codes.4: goal is awaiting approval; run `bm goal inspect <id>` then approve/reject and resume
exit_codes.6: operation unsupported for this harness (see capabilities)
exit_codes.7: conflict: repository lock held, illegal state transition, stale approval, or another supervisor owns the goal

$BM_RUN_DIR/control/review.json.reviewer_id: child id whose meta.json + trusted attestation prove the watcher model

hard_rules: goal.json is replaced atomically (write temp, fsync, rename); events.jsonl is append-only
an illegal transition is refused with exit 7 and never partially applied
completion never equals merge; succeeded means the acceptance record exists for the final revision
an approval is bound to goal_id + attempt_id + revision + contract_digest; a resume under a different revision refuses with exit 7 and records approval_stale
a restart of a partially completed goal is never called resume: it requires --restart and either a retryable outcome or --acknowledge-partial-effects
cancellation records cleanup as confirmed only when the process group is observed gone; otherwise uncertain
unprovable provenance and a missing watcher review fail closed exactly as in schema/acn-contract.json
the state root lives outside the target repository (XDG_STATE_HOME/beastmode/goals) and is never scanned to answer a goal-id lookup
a notification or scheduler trigger never approves, resumes or completes a goal; only bm goal approve/resume/cancel change state
recurring schedules create a fresh goal per occurrence; overlapping or duplicate occurrences are refused, never queued silently

scheduling.owner: the OS scheduler (cron/launchd) owns triggers; Beastmode owns goal state and every gate
scheduling.one_shot: --at resumes the same queued/paused goal once
scheduling.recurring: --every treats the goal as a template; each trigger runs `run --from-template <goal-id> --occurrence <UTC yyyymmddTHHMM>` which creates a fresh goal `<goal-id>-<occurrence>`
scheduling.timezone: UTC (cron export emits CRON_TZ=UTC; launchd calendar entries are rendered host-local and annotated)
scheduling.overlap_policy: reject: the repository lock refuses a second running goal in the same worktree (exit 7); concurrency one never implies no backlog because every skipped occurrence is a visible refusal
scheduling.duplicate_policy: reject: a repeated trigger for the same occurrence token finds the goal id already recorded (exit 7)

notifications.hook: --notify-cmd CMD receives one JSON payload on stdin per (attempt, outcome)
notifications.dedup: notification_id = goal_id:attempt_id:outcome; delivered ids are recorded on the goal
notifications.failure: recorded as a notification_failed event with the bounded error; the verdict is unchanged
notifications.cannot_approve: a notification consumer has no lifecycle authority; approval only happens via bm goal approve
notifications.secrets: payloads contain no credentials; the command reads its own secrets from the environment, never from the goal record

learning_harvest.input: terminal, failed and blocked goal records
learning_harvest.output: a Markdown/JSON proposal of skill and config changes
